nantong-1.name: Langshan
nantong-1.bio: A riverside hill south of Nantong with a Buddhist temple, popular with sailors, and views over the Yangtze.
nantong-1.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. CNY 50 from a 2021 China Daily report; another listing gives 70, so price may be dated or approximate.
nantong-1.held: no verifiable cost: CNY 50 rested on a China Daily Nantong page (2021) that now returns 404, and no other source loads

nantong-2.name: Haohe River Scenic and Historic Spot
nantong-2.bio: A moat-like river ring around Nantong's old city, with evening boat trips and several museums along its banks.
nantong-2.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per Wikivoyage and travelchinaguide; boat trips and some sites inside may charge. No English Wikipedia article titled Haohe.

nantong-3.name: Guangjiao Temple
nantong-3.bio: Buddhist temple on top of Langshan, dedicated to the Bodhisattva Dashizhi.
nantong-3.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Reported as covered by the CNY 50 Langshan scenic-area ticket (2021), not priced separately. Dropped unsourced shard claims (Ming-style hall, Zhiyun Pagoda).
nantong-3.held: no verifiable cost: CNY 50 rested on a China Daily Nantong page (2021) that now returns 404, and no other source loads

nantong-4.name: Nantong Museum
nantong-4.bio: One of China's oldest museums, founded in 1905 by Zhang Jian beside the Haohe, covering Nantong's history.
nantong-4.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. CNY 15 for the South Exhibition Hall and Zhang Jian's residence per travelchinaguide; other halls free. Price may have changed after the Dec 2025 reopening; registered-museum free policy (2025) may apply.

nantong-5.name: Nantong Forest Safari Park
nantong-5.bio: Wildlife park opened in 2018 with nearly 20,000 animals of over 300 species, including pandas and kangaroos.
nantong-5.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Adult CNY 180 (Wikivoyage, updated Jun 2024).

nantong-6.name: Wenfeng Park
nantong-6.bio: Old city park beside Wenfeng Tower, a 39 m five-storey tower dating from 1620.
nantong-6.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per Trip.com (aggregator, price evidence only). Tower climbing reported closed. Dropped unsourced Geyi Art Museum claim.

nantong-7.name: Tangzha Ancient Town
nantong-7.bio: Industrial-heritage town built around the Dasheng Mills, founded by Zhang Jian in 1895 to pioneer machine spinning in China.
nantong-7.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. No ticket price found; 2022 China Daily page returned 404 so facts rest on search summaries.

nantong-8.name: Qiaolou Tower
nantong-8.bio: Old watchtower on the Haohe with a bell tower built in front of it.
nantong-8.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Very thin sourcing; the shard's 1349 date and clock-tower claims are unsourced and dropped. Entry unverified.

nantong-9.name: Nantong Sendi Ice and Snow Park
nantong-9.bio: Indoor ice and snow park next to the Forest Safari Park, with tickets from RMB 158.
nantong-9.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. From RMB 158 (Wikivoyage, updated Jun 2024), so costMin/costMax is the entry-level price. Bio's year-round claim dropped as unsourced.

nantong-10.name: Zhou Ji Green Expo Garden
nantong-10.bio: Green expo garden in Nantong's Tongzhou district, opened free for a day in 2021 as a promotion.
nantong-10.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. No standing price found; '4A' claim unsourced and dropped.

nantong-11.name: Five Mountains
nantong-11.bio: Group of Yangtze hills including Langshan, Junshan and Jianshan, with a riverside greenway and river views.
nantong-11.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Cost for the area as a whole not found (Junshan and Jianshan CNY 20 each in 2021).

nantong-12.name: Nantong Textile Museum
nantong-12.bio: China's first textile museum, opened in 1985, with six exhibition halls set around courtyards and gardens.
nantong-12.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per Nantong registered-museum policy (2025 Yangzhou Evening News); assumes this museum is registered, verify.
nantong-12.held: free entry inferred from a city policy of free admission for registered museums (Yangzhou Evening News, Jul 2025); no source shows this museum is registered or free

nantong-13.name: Chinese Charitable Museum
nantong-13.bio: Museum on the history of charity, named in Nantong's recommended visitor itinerary.
nantong-13.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Very thin facts. Free per registered-museum policy; verify registration.
nantong-13.held: free entry inferred from a city policy of free admission for registered museums (Yangzhou Evening News, Jul 2025); no source shows this museum is registered or free

nantong-14.name: Nantong Eminent Figures Museum
nantong-14.bio: Museum on Nantong's eminent figures, listed in the city's recommended itinerary beside the Grand Theatre.
nantong-14.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Thin facts. Free per registered-museum policy; verify registration.
nantong-14.held: free entry inferred from a city policy of free admission for registered museums (Yangzhou Evening News, Jul 2025); no source shows this museum is registered or free

nantong-15.name: Chinese Ophthalmology Museum
nantong-15.bio: Nantong museum devoted to eye medicine, the only national-level ophthalmology museum in China.
nantong-15.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per registered-museum policy; verify registration.
nantong-15.held: free entry inferred from a city policy of free admission for registered museums (Yangzhou Evening News, Jul 2025); no source shows this museum is registered or free

nantong-16.name: Nantong Traditional Chinese Medicine Culture Museum
nantong-16.bio: Museum of traditional Chinese medicine culture in a building that blends traditional and modern styles.
nantong-16.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per registered-museum policy; verify registration.
nantong-16.held: free entry inferred from a city policy of free admission for registered museums (Yangzhou Evening News, Jul 2025); no source shows this museum is registered or free

wanyuan-pagoda-haian.name: Wanyuan Pagoda
wanyuan-pagoda-haian.bio: Pagoda at Yuantong Temple in northeast Hai'an.
wanyuan-pagoda-haian.notes: UNRESOLVED: research found no source at all; bio is unsourced beyond the placement entry. No English Wikipedia article.

jianghai-museum-haimen.name: Jiangsu Jianghai Museum
jianghai-museum-haimen.bio: Haimen museum whose halls cover local history, Lianghuai salt merchants and guqin displays.
jianghai-museum-haimen.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free-entry status unconfirmed; single travel-note source.

yancheng-1.name: Yancheng Coastal Wetlands
yancheng-1.bio: China's largest coastal wetland reserve, part of the Yellow Sea migratory bird World Heritage site.
yancheng-1.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. No gate price found; access varies by area. Red-crowned cranes best seen in winter (Wikivoyage), kept for destination copy.

yancheng-2.name: Dafeng Milu Nature Reserve
yancheng-2.bio: National reserve on the Yellow Sea coast where Père David's deer were reintroduced in 1986.
yancheng-2.notes: CNY 55 from an undated China Daily listing (2018); other guides give 45-50 online, so approximate. ticketUrl verified homepage of Chinese Milu Park (chinesemlw.com). Dropped unsourced water-tower and viewing-platform claims.

yancheng-3.name: Tiaozini Tidal Flat
yancheng-3.bio: Dongtai tidal flat on a key migratory bird stopover, where over 400 species have been recorded.
yancheng-3.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Facts from search snippets; no price or access info. Core area has restricted access.

yancheng-4.name: Huanghai Forest Park
yancheng-4.bio: Coastal forest park at Gangjiang town in Dongtai.
yancheng-4.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Price only from group-buy listings (about 25 yuan), not recorded.

yancheng-5.name: Xixi Ancient Town
yancheng-5.bio: Dongtai scenic area tied to the Dong Yong and Seven Fairies legend, with a Song-style night-view town.
yancheng-5.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Overall price not found; '5A' and Buddhist claims unsourced and dropped.

yancheng-6.name: Yancheng China Sea Salt Museum
yancheng-6.bio: Museum on Yancheng's salt-making history, free to enter, in the building that also holds Yancheng Museum.
yancheng-6.notes: ticketUrl: no official site found. Free per Wikivoyage (listing updated 2018, dead link); the 2025 news report calls it a national first-class museum.
